reviews.body: **Devin Review** found 2 potential issues.
Thanks for the fix (integration tests ran on a copy of this branch in the livekit repo)

review_comments.body:
🔴 **Retry images overwrite earlier attempts** With `images/{retry}/../shot`, `getImageConfig` accepts a retry, but `clean` removes `{retry}`. Every attempt uploads indexed images under `images/shot`, overwriting earlier images.
Learn more The retry guard checks the request prefix before `clean` normalizes it. Normalization can remove a directory containing `{retry}`, so the guard accepts a prefix whose eventual upload path is identical across attempts. [updatePrefix](https://github.com/livekit/egress/blob/e87404e229536178031619bdbc961e35ac5cf51a/pkg/config/output_image.go#L152-L171 "pkg/config/output_image.go:152-171") splits the normalized path into the storage directory and image prefix; [handleNewImage](https://github.com/livekit/egress/blob/e87404e229536178031619bdbc961e35ac5cf51a/pkg/pipeline/sink/image.go#L125-L148 "pkg/pipeline/sink/image.go:125-148") uploads indexed filenames under that directory. **Example:** On attempt zero and retry one, `images/{retry}/../shot` normalizes to `images/shot`. Both attempts upload `images/shot_00000.jpg`, so retry one replaces attempt zero's image. **Recommended fix:** Normalize the requested prefix before checking for `{retry}`, using the same cleaned value to initialize `ImageConfig`. Add a test that checks the resulting storage path across attempts, not just the returned error.
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🟡 **Auto-named image retries rejected** For a prefix of `.` or `images/..`, `getImageConfig` rejects retries despite `clean` producing an empty prefix. The auto-generated name would include the retry count, so these safe retries fail.
Learn more The guard treats a nonempty request prefix as an explicit image name, but `clean` turns `.` and `images/..` into an empty prefix. [updatePrefix](https://github.com/livekit/egress/blob/e87404e229536178031619bdbc961e35ac5cf51a/pkg/config/output_image.go#L159-L167 "pkg/config/output_image.go:159-167") generates a name for that empty prefix and adds the retry count. The new guard prevents that existing behavior only on retries. **Example:** A user starts an image egress with filename prefix `.` and retries it after failure. The first run gets a generated filename, but the retry returns `ErrNonRetryableOutput` instead of generating a retry-specific filename. **Recommended fix:** Run the retry guard against the cleaned prefix that is actually passed to `updatePrefix`, and treat an empty cleaned prefix as auto-named.
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*
✅ **Resolved**: The guard now checks the cleaned prefix, so a {retry} component removed by normalization no longer passes validation.
✅ **Resolved**: The guard now sees the empty cleaned prefix and permits auto-generated retry names.

comments.body:
Good catch on both: the guard now runs on the cleaned prefix, in the same order as `getFileConfig`/`getSegmentConfig`. Tests added for `images/{retry}/../shot`, `.` and `images/..`.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
